svg.aria-label: Motion storyboard for the Reader and the Library (issue #724): nine moments drawn as frame strips with times, a timeline and the easing — the cover opening into the page, a highlight settling into the margin, the popover growing from the selection, ink per meaning, search you can see, the chapter ending, the shelf, the theme cross-fade and the back pill — and the rules every motion keeps
svg.text: Motion storyboard — the Reader and the Library
Each strip reads left to right; times are from the start of the gesture. Issue #724.
The cover opens into the page
The cover you clicked becomes the page (FLIP); closing plays it backwards.
A faint ghost of the kept passage drifts into its card, then settles.
The popover grows from the selection
Grown from where you selected (transform-origin); a footnote grows from its ¹.
The marker sweeps in the colour you chose (Idea yellow, Question blue…), then settles.
Matches tint in, the current one breathes once; ticks on the edge show where.
A quiet ornament fades in as the progress line fills. No numbers.

text.tspan: · lift 4 px, breathe once on open

svg.text: Covers have depth and a spine shadow, lift on hover; the resume card breathes once.

text.tspan: · opacity of a top layer, 250 ms a step

svg.text: Day → sepia → night: the new theme fades in over the old; text never moves.

text.tspan: · slides 8 px, fades out by itself

svg.text: After an in-book link the pill slides down, then fades away on its own.
The cover opens into the page: FLIP, ≤400 ms, and back
A highlight finds its place: a ghost settles into its card
The popover grows from the selection; a footnote from ¹
Ink per meaning: the sweep in the chosen colour
Search you can see: tint, one breath, ticks on the edge
Chapter ending: a quiet ornament, the line fills
The shelf: depth, a lift on hover, one breath
The back pill: slides down, fades by itself
Every moment above keeps all five.

text.tspan: transform and opacity, never layout, size or text colour.
for everything; the cover alone may take up to 400 ms.
one set of durations and easings for the whole plugin.
an instant equivalent, the same end state.
no sound, confetti, badges or counts.
fast 120 ms · base 250 ms · cover 400 ms · ease-out-quint
